visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a close-up shot of two black bento boxes filled with quinoa rice, sliced herb chicken, and various colorful vegetables like broccoli and cherry tomatoes. A hand holding chopsticks lifts a piece of meat. (2) The scene cuts to a kitchen where a person pours a large amount of chopped green onions from a metal bowl into a frying pan filled with hot oil and garlic. (3) A chef is seen stir-frying diced meat with red chilies in a black wok over a bright blue gas flame, with intense heat causing the food to toss in the air. (4) Close-up shots show the cooking of several dishes: tofu cubes simmering in a dark, bubbling sauce and a variety of side dishes including a soft-boiled egg, corn, and zucchini being arranged in a bento box. (5) A pair of chopsticks picks up a clump of quinoa rice next to a piece of broccoli. Another shot shows diced garlic pork being scooped onto white rice. (6) In the preparation area, a person wearing purple gloves massages herb seasoning into raw pink chicken breasts laid out on a metal tray. (7) A cooked chicken breast is sliced precisely on a white cutting board using a sharp metal knife. (8) A large slice of the herb-crusted chicken is lifted with chopsticks, showing its thick texture. Another variety of chicken with scallion oil is also showcased. (9) Slices of red beef on a plate are being seared with a blue blowtorch flame. Chopsticks then lift a slice of the medium-rare beef to show the pink interior. (10) A piece of black-crusted fried chicken is held up. The video ends with a person holding a sealed bento box in front of a restaurant sign featuring a muscular cartoon chef, followed by an exterior shot of the shop '森度餐廚' located in a narrow urban alleyway with parked scooters.
